structures.label: Deltoid, anterior part
structures.description: Front third of the deltoid, arising from the outer clavicle.
structures.function: Raises the arm forward (flexion) and turns it inwards.

structures.label: Deltoid, middle part
structures.description: Middle third of the deltoid, arising from the acromion.
structures.function: Lifts the arm out to the side (abduction), especially from 15° to 90°.

structures.label: Deltoid, posterior part
structures.description: Back third of the deltoid, arising from the spine of the scapula.
structures.function: Pulls the arm backwards (extension) and turns it outwards.

structures.label: Pectoralis major
structures.description: Large fan-shaped chest muscle running from the clavicle and sternum to the humerus.
structures.function: Brings the arm across the body, turns it inwards and pushes forwards.

structures.label: Biceps brachii
structures.description: Two-headed front arm muscle; the long head tendon runs over the top of the humeral head.
structures.function: Bends the elbow, turns the palm up and helps raise the arm forward.

structures.label: Trapezius, upper fibers
structures.description: Upper part of the trapezius, from the neck to the outer clavicle.
structures.function: Lifts and rotates the shoulder blade upwards when raising the arm.

structures.label: Supraspinatus
structures.description: Rotator cuff muscle above the spine of the scapula; its tendon passes under the acromion.
structures.function: Starts lifting the arm sideways and keeps the humeral head centred in the socket.

structures.label: Infraspinatus
structures.description: Rotator cuff muscle covering the back of the shoulder blade below its spine.
structures.function: Turns the arm outwards and stabilises the back of the joint.

structures.label: Teres minor
structures.description: Small rotator cuff muscle along the outer border of the scapula.
structures.function: Turns the arm outwards and stabilises the humeral head.

structures.label: Subscapularis
structures.description: Rotator cuff muscle on the front surface of the shoulder blade, against the ribs.
structures.function: Turns the arm inwards and stabilises the front of the joint.

structures.label: Pectoralis minor
structures.description: Thin muscle under the pectoralis major, from ribs 3–5 to the coracoid process.
structures.function: Pulls the shoulder blade forwards and down.

structures.label: Glenoid labrum
structures.description: Ring of fibrocartilage around the rim of the shoulder socket.
structures.function: Deepens the socket and anchors the biceps tendon and ligaments.

structures.label: Joint capsule
structures.description: Loose fibrous sleeve around the shoulder joint, thickened by the glenohumeral ligaments.
structures.function: Holds the joint together while allowing the largest range of motion in the body.

structures.label: Coracohumeral ligament
structures.description: Band from the coracoid process to the top of the humerus.
structures.function: Limits the humeral head from sliding down and over-rotating outwards.

structures.label: Acromioclavicular joint
structures.description: Small joint between the clavicle and acromion, with the ligaments that hold it.
structures.function: Links the arm to the collarbone; its ligaments tear in a "separated shoulder".

structures.label: Subdeltoid bursa
structures.description: Fluid-filled sac between the deltoid and the rotator cuff.
structures.function: Lets the cuff glide under the deltoid and acromion; it inflames in impingement.

structures.label: Humerus (proximal)
structures.description: Upper arm bone; its rounded head sits in the shoulder socket.
structures.function: Lever for every shoulder movement and attachment for the cuff and deltoid.

structures.label: Scapula
structures.description: Shoulder blade, with the glenoid socket, acromion and coracoid process.
structures.function: Mobile base of the shoulder; it glides on the ribcage as the arm moves.

structures.label: Clavicle
structures.description: Collarbone, joining the sternum to the shoulder blade.
structures.function: Strut that keeps the shoulder away from the chest and transmits force to the trunk.
